title: Greetings in the Community
subject: English Language
objectives: Greet elders in the community politely
Understand how to address people outside the home

blocks.alt: A child greeting an elder in the community
blocks.caption: Aisha greets Mallam Idris in the village.

blocks.md: In the community, we greet adults politely. **Mallam** is a respectful title used for a man. When an elder asks a question, we answer politely with **'Mallam'** or **'Sir'**.

lines.speaker: Mallam Idris
lines.text: You have come early to play today.

lines.speaker: Mallam Idris
lines.text: Is Mohammed also doing well at school?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: He is coming along with us, Mallam.

blocks.md: **Remember:** Always greet elders politely. You can say **'Good morning, sir'** or **'Good evening, ma'** depending on the time of day and the person.

quiz.q: What title do the children use to greet the man?
What does Mallam Idris ask Aisha about?
quiz.explain: Mallam Idris asks 'how is your school?'

quiz.q: Who is coming along with the children?
quiz.explain: Aisha says Jibril is coming along with them.
